composition_variation: Portray adult Shinobu Kocho in a sunlit greenhouse wearing a fully covering butterfly-patterned outer jacket over a high-neck lavender dress. She bends slightly to inspect a potted violet flower without touching it. Use delicate botanical illustration, lilac and sage colors, translucent glass reflections, and white rim light. Keep her hair ornament recognizable and her expression gentle, with no sword or combat accessories. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
